Lost Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 6:28pm

Ingredients




4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
Salt and Pepper
cup fresh lime juice
1 pkt dry Italian salad dressing mix I use Go
cup margarine melted

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper to taste. 2 Mix together lime juice, salad dressing mix, and margarine. 3 Place chicken in a 13x9x2" baking dish. Pour sauce over chicken, making sure all surfaces are coated. Cover with foil. 4 Bake 1 hour, removing foil 15 minutes before cooking time is finished.
